detail.title: 4 MP AI Enforcement Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC431-RW1F-L 4 MP AI Enforcement Camera Key Points • 1/1.8" 4 MP Starlight CMOS Sensor with A Resolution of 2688 × 1520 • ANPR Distance Covers up to 30 m • Covers up to 2 Lanes • Speeds Up to 180 km/h • IP66 Waterproof and IK10 Vandal Proof Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Camera.Image Resolution: 2688 (H) × 1520 (V) (OSD black background is not calculated in the pixels)

Illuminator.Illuminator Number: 4 illuminators (3500 K LED illuminator, brightness adjustable)

Lens.Exposure Mode: Auto; Manual (Select from shutter values or customize shutter range)

Function.OSD Overlay: Time, address, device SN, lane No., plate number, plate color, vehicle logo, vehicle type, vehicle color, vehicle size, vehicle speed, country/region, event (violation name), and motorcycle attributes (type, number of people, and helmet)
Function.Alarm Event: Storage full; storage error; external alarm; no storage card; license plate blocklist; illegal access; network disconnection; IP conflict
Function.Automatic Network Replenishment (ANR): Platform and FTP (TF card is required)

Intelligence.ANPR: Adopts developed algorithms to recognize license plate numbers and letters
Intelligence.Vehicle Type Recognition: Vehicle head: SUV, Large bus, sedan, light truck, pickup, heavy truck, medium truck, van, medium bus, MPV Vehicle tail: SUV, large bus, sedan, light truck, pickup, heavy truck, medium truck, van
Intelligence.Vehicle Color Recognition: White, pink, black, red, yellow, gray, blue, green, dark orange, purple, brown, and silver gray
Intelligence.Vehicle Brand/Logo Recognition: Acura; Alfaromeo; Ashokleyland; Astonmartin; Audi; Baic; Bently; Benz; BMW; Buick; BYD; Cadillac; Chery; Chevrolet; Chrysler; Citroen; Dacia; Daihatsu; Datsun; Dodge; DS; Ferrari; Fiat; Force; Ford; Foton; Geely; GMC; Greatwall; Hino; Honda; Hyundai; Infiniti; Isuzu; Iveco; Jac; Jaguar; Jeep; Kia; Kinglong; Land; Lexus; Lifan; Lincoln; Mahindra; MAN; Maserati; Mazda; Mercury; MG; Mini; Mitsubishi; Nissan; Opel; Peugeot; Porsche; Renault; Rollsroyce; Saab; Scania; Seat; Skoda; Smart; Subaru; Suzuki; Tata; Tesla; Toyota; UD; Volkswagen; Volvo
Intelligence.Motor Vehicle Violation Capture: Speeding; driving slow; wrong-way driving; illegal lane change
Intelligence.Motorcycle Violation Capture: Captures traffic violations including carrying passenger, not wearing helmet, and wrong-way driving
Intelligence.Traffic Flow Detection: Statistics on vehicle flow, average speed, vehicle type, lane occupancy, average time headway, average queue length, and road status
Intelligence.Traffic Event: Motor vehicle illegal stopping on the roadway; traffic congestion

Video.Video Frame Rate: Max. 30 fps; main stream (2688 × 1520@25 fps), sub stream (1600 × 1200@25 fps)
Video.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–32767 kbps H.265: 32 kbps–32767 kbps MJPEG: 512 kbps–32767 kbps
Video.White Balance: Auto; Manual; Outdoor; Natural; Street Lamp; Partial white balance

Image.Composite Image: Supports combining up to 3 source images, and 1 close-up image into a composite image
Image.Image Resolution: 2688 (H) × 1520 (V) (OSD black background is not calculated in the pixels)
Image.Image Tampering Prevention: Verifies watermarks in videos and images

Network.Network Port: 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet port, 10/100/1000 M network transmission
Network.Security: Authorized username and password, MAC address binding, HTTPS encryption, and network access control
Network.Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; IP; UDP; NTP; DHCP
Network.Browser: Microsoft Edge IE: IE9–IE11 Chrome: Chrome 41 and earlier Firefox: Firefox 49 and earlier For Win 10 users, run the browser as administrator

Port.Storage: 1, supports maximum 512 GB TF card local storage
Port.RS-485: 2, connects to devices such as radars
Port.RS-232: 2, con is used for serial debugging and R T G is for connecting to radars

General.Installation: Installs with universal mounting brackets, or as a side-mount with mounting brackets.
